title: Questionnaire Autofill (RFP Responder)
summary: An intelligent agent that uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to answer security questionnaires (Excel, CSV) using the organization's existing Policy and Control data.
goals: Reduce time spent on vendor security questionnaires by 90%.
Ensure consistent answers across different customers.
Leverage existing compliance data as the 'source of truth'.

user_stories.outcome: the system populates the 'Answer' column with high-confidence responses based on our live policies.
edit them if necessary and approve them, adding the final approved answer to the knowledge base for future use.
search specific policy PDF content to find the nuance required.

acceptance_criteria: System parses uploaded Excel/CSV headers correctly.
For each question, the system retrieves relevant chunks from vector DB.
Generated answers reference the specific Policy they are derived from.
User can export the completed file.
